_comment: Settings for the model runs (Test A = image only, Test B = image + the region's rule passages). No secrets in this file: the API key is read from the environment variable named in api.api_key_env, which you keep in the .env file of the repository (Git ignores .env). Every run saves a copy of these settings (without the key) in runs/<run_id>/manifest.json. Relative workspaces are resolved under DATASETS_ROOT (environment or .env), else under datasets_root.

data_policy._comment: Collections whose images may be sent to the OpenAI API. own_video is the author's own footage. Add bdd100k / culane only after the dataset owners have confirmed in writing that sending images to a third-party API for non-commercial course research is allowed (README, 'Data sent to the API').
